title: Electrical Power — Aft Secondary Distribution Box — Ventilation Duct and Higher Rated Terminations

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the ventilation duct and higher rated terminations in the aft secondary distribution box, restoring the full cabin outlet rating that the interim derating had removed.

sections.planning_reason: The interim derating protected the fleet but left the aft cabin outlets at three quarters of their design rating, which operators find increasingly restrictive as cabin electrical fit grows. Thermal modelling shows that a small forced ventilation flow taken from the existing equipment rack extraction, together with higher rated terminations, brings the terminal temperature 24 degrees below the qualification limit under the worst ground case with every outlet loaded. This bulletin brings delivered aircraft to that standard and withdraws the cabin placard.
sections.description: A ventilation duct is run from the aft equipment rack extraction plenum to a new inlet on the lower face of the secondary distribution box, an internal baffle directs the flow over the cabin outlet feeder terminals, the harness is re-terminated with higher rated lugs and the feeder relay is replaced by an item qualified to the higher continuous rating.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-energise the aircraft and apply the electrical safety precautions. Open the aft equipment rack access in zones 244 and 252 and remove the secondary distribution box from its mounting. Cut the ventilation inlet in the lower face using the template from the tooling set and deburr the opening. Install the internal baffle and set the standoff with spacers AES140047-2A. Re-terminate the harness D2450122851975 with the higher rated lugs and refit the connector HAR83831-56. Replace the feeder relay CIDE636017-51. Refit the box and run the ventilation duct to the extraction plenum, supporting it at the pitch given in the accomplishment instructions. Re-strap the feeder contactor 89PC to the restored group allocation and confirm the box bus bar 403XU2 strapping. Do the ventilation flow measurement at the box inlet and the cabin outlet functional check at every seat row. Remove the cabin placard, install the access panels and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00431 that are pre modification standard, whether or not the interim derating has been embodied. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00434 onward carry the ventilated box from build. Aircraft on which the duct alone has already been fitted for another reason should use the companion terminations bulletin instead.
sections.material_note: Kit K2450-1031-01 contains the duct, the baffle, the relay, the lug set and the cutting template hire. Lead time is fourteen weeks. The removed relay is returned to Aeralis for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

revision_history.reason: Ventilation flow measurement made mandatory; duct support pitch corrected in step 8
Effectivity extended to aircraft that never embodied the interim derating; cabin placard removal added as a closing step
